title: Cross-host mailboxes: TermAl mailboxes work between independent hosts for normal coordination
outcome: Remote is a first-class citizen: a TermAl session on one host can exchange durable mailbox messages with a session on another independent host for ordinary coordination (assignments, reports, acknowledgements, wakes), with explicit host and session identity, authority, idempotent dedup across hosts and recovery after loss of contact. Operator relay remains only a temporary fallback. No code is written before the joint design is accepted and broken into small slices.
acceptance: A joint design by Termal::Architect1 and Termal::Architect2 is recorded on this epic, covering transport, host/session identity and authority (no impersonation), cross-host idempotency and dedup, delivery vs wake vs processing semantics, recovery after loss of contact or restart, and what never crosses hosts (stores, credentials, credit); the coordinator and Greg have it before any implementation.
The design is broken into small, independently landable child slices with their own test-bound criteria; this epic completes when its required children complete.
